postmortem.source: 1466 local observation samples plus final native memory snapshot
causes: Tower draining took place at the east border; core defenders were never approached. Boundary crossings did not constitute luring.
The gate remained intact. The tank had only 30 melee damage per tick; the 750-damage dismantler was globally held whenever any military defender existed anywhere in the room.

The old five-tile contact retreat and fixed arena-only support prevented a supported local fight. Medical replacement and border traffic defects also interrupted pressure; those earlier defects were fixed during the operation.
Repeated tower refills prevented treating a brief cold window as a supply blockade. Enemy safe mode ended the operation; it was not the original cause of failed pursuit.
postmortem.inference: Core patrol positions are consistent with a defensive leash, but opponent source code and chase trigger were not observed. Pursuit cannot be assumed.

sequence: No spawning before the native safe-mode expiry tick. Recheck current room safety on launch and before each spawn.
Drain with two tanks and medical support; require five consecutive visible ticks with every tower below ten energy.

Fund the breaker immediately after the initial medic, tank and ranged unit. Open the entry while distant guards remain; require a local screen, medical cover and a six-tile defender buffer at the work site.

Advance the primary tank with two mobile medics and the ranged unit during the verified cold window. The breaker follows the screened formation and dismantles only when its immediate work site is safe. Other support holds the arena while enemy military remains.

At contact, fight if conservative local damage, healing, remaining body parts and health predict victory with a survival margin. Only currently present units count; include boosts and hostile healing, and avoid double-counting ranged shooting with ranged healing.
When the local fight cannot be won, pull toward E58S44 and engage with the arena support. Tower refill closes forward permissions and recalls exposed support.
Track arena presence, accepted attack intents and actual target hit loss separately. Returning bait without a follower records a failed lure.
limits: A core guard may refuse to follow. A guaranteed lure is not claimed.
Advancing through an empty-tower window risks losses if towers refill before the formation returns; the 30000 gross cap limits spending, not casualties.
No boosts or market purchases. No automatic second operation or budget increase.
Withdrawal remains mandatory for safe mode, hostile power creeps, approach-route reinforcements, owner changes, accounting faults and the operation deadline.
